sum: Scheme of Arrangement - We wish to inform you that on Thursday, October 15, 2026 the Company has received the Certified true copy of the final order pronounced by Hon'ble Tribunal (NCLT) after its hearing held on Monday 28 September, 2026.…
detail: Scheme of Arrangement - We wish to inform you that on Thursday, October 15, 2026 the Company has received the Certified true copy of the final order pronounced by Hon'ble Tribunal (NCLT) after its hearing held on Monday 28 September, 2026. The appointed date of the Scheme is April 01, 2026.
